title: ORR spec v1
description: One municipal open records request, as handed to the ORR eDiscovery tool. Unknown fields are rejected. Rules this schema cannot express are enforced by Test-OrrSpec in ORR.Core: the client must exist in clients.json; every custodian and team mailbox must be in that client's AllowedDomains and every site in its AllowedSharePointHosts; dateEnd must not be before dateStart; 'sharepoint' in locations requires at least one entry in sites; there must be at least one custodian, site or team mailbox; every keyword must be searchable.

ticketNumber.description: ConnectWise ticket number, as a number without quotes.

client.description: Client key exactly as written in clients.json (case-sensitive).

requester.description: Person or organisation that made the records request.

requestSummary.description: What was requested, in a sentence or two.

custodians.description: Email addresses of the people whose records are requested. Each person is searched as one source covering their mailbox (email and Teams chats) and their OneDrive. May be empty only when sites or teamMailboxes are given.

dateStart.description: First day of the requested period, YYYY-MM-DD.

dateEnd.description: Last day of the requested period, YYYY-MM-DD. The whole day is included.

keywords.description: Words or phrases to search for; an item matches if it contains any of them. A phrase of several words is matched exactly. A single word may end in * (at least 3 letters first) to match words that start with it. An empty list means every item in the date range.

kqlOverride.description: A complete KQL query to use instead of the one built from keywords and dates, or null. When set, keywords are ignored and dateStart/dateEnd are NOT added to the query.

locations.description: Which kinds of content were requested.

sites.description: SharePoint site addresses (or a former employee's OneDrive address) to search. Required when locations includes sharepoint.

teamMailboxes.description: Email addresses of Microsoft Teams teams or Microsoft 365 groups whose channel messages or group mail were requested. Channel messages are stored in the team's group mailbox, not in each member's mailbox.

action.description: "search" stops after the estimate. "export" also allows an export, which still needs the technician's confirmation after a completed estimate.
